value.answer: Honestly, the Honda Odyssey for me. U.S. News has it #1 with a 9.3 out of 10, Car Talk's staff picked it, and Edmunds says it's the minivan it most likes to drive. If mileage matters most, the Toyota Sienna is the one to get, at 36 mpg combined. If you need the most cargo room, the Kia Carnival holds 145.1 cu ft with the seats folded. The rankings split on this, so it comes down to what you care about most.
